title.en: The largest k from a stream

hints.tr: Döngüde: `len(heap) < k` ise `heappush`; `elif x > heap[0]:` ise `heapreplace(heap, x)`.
hints.en: In the loop: `heappush` if `len(heap) < k`; `heapreplace(heap, x)` if `elif x > heap[0]:`.

hint.en: Do not use `sorted`; use a heap.
Do not use `nlargest`; keep the heap yourself.
